headword: {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}

definitions.explanation: Ability or talent that exists but has not yet been developed or demonstrated. Used in business, education, sports, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Education that draws out latent abilities is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: The coach said that player has high potential and an exciting future ahead.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{潜在|せんざい}→潜在：13390_senzai⟧ (latent, hidden) and ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability). Emphasizes untapped or unrealized ability, unlike ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ alone which can refer to demonstrated ability.

Often shortened to ポテンシャル in casual speech, especially in business and sports contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧ (to draw out potential)
- {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ (to demonstrate latent ability)
- {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (to have high potential)
- {潜在能力|せんざいのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{秘|ひ}める→秘める：13759_himeru⟧ (to harbor hidden talent)
